scripts.build: npm run b:module && npm run b:types
scripts.format: oxfmt packages tests examples e2e .github package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.tests.json rolldown.config.mjs rollup-plugin-glsl.mjs vitest.config.ts .oxfmtrc.jsonc .oxlintrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check packages tests examples e2e .github package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.tests.json rolldown.config.mjs rollup-plugin-glsl.mjs vitest.config.ts .oxfmtrc.jsonc .oxlintrc.json
scripts.watch: cross-env NODE_ENV=release BUILD_TYPE=MODULE rolldown -cw -m inline --config rolldown.config.mjs
scripts.watch:umd: cross-env NODE_ENV=release BUILD_TYPE=UMD rolldown -cw -m inline --config rolldown.config.mjs
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development BUILD_TYPE=MODULE rolldown -cw -m inline --config rolldown.config.mjs
scripts.b:types: pnpm -r --filter=./packages/* run b:types && pnpm -C e2e run b:types
scripts.b:all: cross-env NODE_ENV=release npm run b:types && cross-env BUILD_TYPE=ALL NODE_ENV=release rolldown --config rolldown.config.mjs
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist && pnpm -r exec rm -rf types
